subject.title: Plugin prerelease no-write validation fails workflow startup

question: Should the release workflow owners authorize the narrow graph split that keeps artifact-only Plugin Prerelease validation read-only while preserving explicit publication callers?
rationale: The technical defect and safe direction are clear, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an owner to approve changes to shared release workflow boundaries.

options.title: Authorize write-free graph split
options.body: Separate artifact-only validation from registry publication and require focused tests and exact-SHA startup proof for both paths.

options.title: Choose another owner-approved structure
options.body: Preserve the same least-privilege and publication contracts through a different shared-workflow decomposition.

recommendation.title: Authorize write-free graph split
recommendation.body: Separate artifact-only validation from registry publication and require focused tests and exact-SHA startup proof for both paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the issue assignee, owns general GitHub workflows through CODEOWNERS, and recently maintained the affected Plugin Prerelease path.
